title: UI image canonicalization workflow for onboarding assets
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Summary: Create a repeatable, auditable workflow ("canonization") for producing brand-consistent onboarding and quickstart screenshots and inline doc visuals. The workflow should automatically handle redaction of sensitive data, cropping and aspect-ratio normalization, and localization-safe layout checks to prevent clipped translations. This ticket covers the design artifacts, export rules, filename/versioning conventions, QA checks, and handoff to engineering for automation (CI/GHA).

Background: Our current screenshot pool is inconsistent — mixed padding, variable device frames, occasional real-user data, and localized strings that overflow or get truncated. This causes churn for engineers and docs owners when releasing new versions. We need a single source-of-truth canonical pipeline so assets in docs, release notes, and the console look consistent and pass security/privacy reviews.

Goals:
- Define visual rules and templates (Figma) for canonical exports across breakpoints and densities.
- Specify redaction policy and automation heuristics (PII patterns, tokens, masked values).
- Create localization-safe cropping/spacing rules and an overflow detection checklist to be enforced at export time.
- Provide clear file naming/versioning conventions and a migration plan for existing screenshots.
- Deliver design tokens and example exports for Eng to implement in automated pipeline (GitHub Actions + GCS artifact store).

Non-goals: Full engineering implementation (handled by ENG ticket), bulk re-export of all historical assets (handled in a follow-up migration ticket).
acceptance_criteria:
1) Figma library contains canonical templates for desktop, tablet, and mobile with named export presets.
2) Design spec lists exact padding, safe-area margins, and label font sizes for each breakpoint.
3) Redaction rules documented with regex examples and three sample screenshots showing before/after redaction.
4) Localization-safe checklist and automated overflow test spec (screenshot-level detection rules) documented.
5) Filename convention and semantic versioning example present (e.g., onboarding.signin.desktop.v1.2.png).
6) Hand-off package uploaded to Drive with link and a linked ENG ticket for implementation.
7) Two cross-functional reviews completed (PM + Security) and review notes captured.
tasks: Create Figma canonical templates (desktop/tablet/mobile) with export tokens
Draft redaction policy: list PII patterns and masking conventions (email, API keys, tokens, UUIDs)
Design localization-safe layout rules: min line-height, wrap anchors, and truncation fallbacks
Define cropping & padding matrix for 16:9, 4:3, 3:2, and 1:1 outputs
Write file naming and versioning guide and example mapping to release names
Produce three before/after sample assets showing redaction and localized variants
Compile handoff ZIP and upload to Drive; create ENG implementation ticket with requirements
